entries.text: I thought I might come see what this was about,\nsince I was invited by a fellow true artist like\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]-garde...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_first_00

entries.text: But my word! The design of this room!\c\nIt goes beyond all pedestrian understanding of\nwhat a room should be! Truly avant-garde![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_first_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], I thank you for
inviting
me
to
this
place.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_00

entries.text: I only recently finished my latest piece, and so\nI rushed over to find a bit of rest and reprieve.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_01

entries.text: It seems that no matter the region, the wild\ncreature known as the “adolescent” changes\r\nlittle, no?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_02

entries.text: But that dome! That magnificent Terarium!\c\nIt’s the perfect “mariage” of environments,\ninspiring in me an unyielding desire to create![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_03

entries.text: That’s really great!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_select_01

entries.text: You mean “marriage”?
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_select_02

entries.text: How curious it is that my happiness should bring\nyou happiness as well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_05

entries.text: No, I mean “mariage”—the perfect blending of\ndifferent elements that results in great art! No\r\nword in our native tongue conveys such elegance![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_05b

entries.text: I would love to climb up to that mysterious objet\nd’art dangling from the ceil of the dome.\c\nWhat sights I might gaze down upon from there![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Apropos of nothing, [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
I
must
ask—![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_00

entries.text: There is another famed artist here in the Unova\nregion. Do you know of him?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_01

entries.text: Of course I do!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_select_01

entries.text: I have no idea
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Oh, how broad and rich your education is!\nYes, I suspected you would already know...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_05

entries.text: Is that right! Well, if you do not know, I simply\nmust inform you![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_05b

entries.text: I speak of that famed painter of bug Pokémon,\nwhose works have such depth and pathos![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_02

entries.text:
I find myself quite curious about him, as it seems
that we may be alike in temperament.\c
We both strive to propel ourselves to the height
of artistic creation by focusing on a single type...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_03

entries.text: I’ve heard he maintains a gallery of his work in\nCastelia City. Perhaps I shall pay it a visit...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp02_04

entries.text: I visited the gallery of that famed painter I spoke\nof before. The one in Castelia City.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_00

entries.text: It was truly...avant-garde![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_01

entries.text: There was silk like Tarountula’s, spun into\nmasterful sculptures that whisk one around like\r\nfantastic elevators![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_02

entries.text: I rode up and down countless times for the sheer\njoy of it![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_03

entries.text: Upon which I gradually became all tangled up in\nthe webbing and was transformed into a cocoon![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_05

entries.text: That’s right... Before I even realized what was\nhappening, I myself had become a part of the\r\nfibrous art. It was wondrous![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_06

entries.text: That sounds great!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_select_01

entries.text: I don’t get it
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_select_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yes, you and I truly understand one another!
You should come join me as an apprentice in the
future, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’ll teach you
all
I know![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_07

entries.text: You fail to understand? Hmm. Now I wonder if\nwhat I experienced was perhaps not intended by\r\nthe artist...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_07b

entries.text: You know, now that I think back on my visit, that\ngallery had no paintings on display.\c\nWas it truly an art gallery at all?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_sp03_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hahahaha! I suppose it matters naught! Talking to
you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], is a pleasure
regardless—one
that
makes
me
forget
time
is
even
passing.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_01_00

entries.text: I imagine you must feel the same!\c\nAnd for such a like-minded ally in art, I have a\nproposal to make...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_01_01

entries.text: Would you like to engage in an artistic exchange\nof Pokémon with me?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_01_02

entries.text: Very good, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]-garde!\c\nI will offer up one of my Sunflora! How will you\nmeet such a challenge?![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_01_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]! What a beguiling choice.\c\nI can feel inspiration welling up within me! Your\neye for beauty delights me once again![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Will you exchange your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for my\nSunflora?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Brassius a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Brassius such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Brassius a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Wait, no! Have you taken leave of your senses?!
You can’t trade with only a single Pokémon!\c
Be certain you have at least two Pokémon in your
party if you wish to make our exchange![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_03_00

entries.text: A Pokémon trade is an exchange of lives. It is\nwise to give it all due consideration.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_03_01

entries.text: Have you decided you would like to trade with\nme after all?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_trade_04_00

entries.text: I have some time before my next lecture. Care to\ncollaborate with me in the art of battle?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_talkto_00

entries.text: There’s nothing to be done about it if you lack\nthe necessary passion. I will not force you.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_cancel_00

entries.text: Superb! Then let us move to the entrance of the\nschool with great artistic flair![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Hahahaha! You have claimed an artistic win![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: Our collaborations are always the greatest of\nworks! Your sense for art is honed to perfection![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: My thanks to you.\c\nI will bestow on you the latest merchandise to be\nsold at my exhibits. You’ll be the first to get one.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: It took the designers over six months to meet my\nexacting standards, but at last we made true art.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You received a [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Surrendering Sunflora Case [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nBrassius!
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_reward_00

entries.text: Hahahaha! What an artistic defeat!\c\nSince you’ve already gotten the best of me, you\nmight as well take a little more![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: I can’t hold back this flood of inspiration... Leave\nme here, so I might continue to savor this feeling![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: So this time you served to nourish my Pokémon!\c\nThe occasional defeat is a necessarily evil. Our\npain can inspire the greatest art![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
The architecture of this academy displays a great
sense of design.\c
I would like to know the name of the architect
who devised it...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
In Pokémon battles, there will be times of
struggle. The same is true of art.\c
But you must not abandon these pursuits. It is
when you stop struggling that you wither away.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
You have had the opportunity to take Hass’s
classes back in Paldea, have you not?\c
You should be aware of how lucky you are as you
make your way in life.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’d love to do a carving of the [VAR 0x0101(0001)]
you
entrusted
me with, at some point.\c
It is truly avant-garde![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_03

entries.text: Is the Sunflora I entrusted you with flourishing?\c\nYou must be diligent in ensuring he gets enough\nsunlight and water.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]La Primera stopped by to whisper a little secret
in my ear, not long ago.\c
She said that when you were asked to name your
favorite Gym Leader, you said it was me!\c
If I’ve been deemed worthy by your great eye,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]-garde, I can aspire no
higher!\c
Let our next collaboration together be one that
I dedicate to the theme of “Gratitude”![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_randomtalk_sp
